hospital_course: The patient with a past history of a thyroid disorder and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus presented with complaints of multiple episodes of loose stools, vomiting, fatigue for 3 days, and fever for one day. Initial investigations revealed elevated serum creatinine (1.65 mg/dl), low serum sodium (128.00 mmol/L), and a urine routine showing ketone bodies, pus cells, and bacteria. The patient was admitted and treated with IV fluids, IV antibiotics, IV PPIs, and IV antiemetics. Repeat serum creatinine improved to 1.17 mg/dl. TSH and Free T4 were normal. USG of the abdomen and pelvis showed Grade-I fatty liver changes, mildly edematous ascending colon suggestive of colitis, and cholelithiasis. The patient was advised to stay for further management but was discharged at the request of the attenders.
follow_up: Review immediately in case of fever, loose stools, vomiting, fatigue. Review on 09.03.2026. CBC. Urine culture and sensitivity sent- report awaited. Diet counselling done for strict diet modification, allow low oil foods, include fiber rich foods.
pending_results: Urine culture and sensitivity report awaited (as per discharge summary text).
